description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Less than a mile to Wall Street Public Beach Access* 6-Seater Golf Cart Included * 4 Bikes Included* Community Pool Across the Street* Pet Friendly (1 pet under 20 lbs. add'l $250 fee applies)* Private Backyard Oasis – Enjoy outdoor dining, relax around the fire pit, and make lasting memories under the stars.* Walking distance to 30Avenue for shopping, entertainment, and dining* Take the new underground tunnel from 30Avenue directly to 30A for more beach accesses, shopping, and dining* Walking distance to some of the best restaurants in 30A! - Cuvee 30A, amici 30A, Aja 30A, and Canopy Road Café details below* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service**This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.** Please be aware that access to the Upper Deck is temporarily unavailable. **Nestled in the heart of Inlet Beach, Willow & Waves is a beautifully appointed 3-bedroom plus a loft, 2.5-bath coastal retreat that comfortably sleeps up to 7 guests. Just a 2-minute golf cart ride from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf and only moments from Rosemary Beach and Scenic Highway 30A, this inviting home offers the perfect blend of relaxation, convenience, and coastal charm. Step inside to a bright, open-concept living space designed for gathering with family and friends. The spacious living room provides plenty of comfortable seating and a large flat-screen TV, making it the perfect place to unwind with a movie after a day at the beach. The fully equipped kitchen features everything you need to prepare delicious family meals, while the dining table seats 8 guests and the breakfast bar offers seating for 4, ensuring everyone has a place to enjoy meals together. Upstairs, the second floor features three comfortable bedrooms, including the spacious master suite with a king bed and private en-suite bathroom. Two additional guest bedrooms each offer a queen bed and share a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom. On the third floor, you'll find a cozy loft featuring a twin daybed—an ideal hideaway for reading, relaxing, or sleeping. Outside, your private backyard is the perfect place to enjoy Florida evenings. Fire up the grill, dine al fresco on the patio, or gather around the fire pit for conversation and s'mores under the stars. Directly across the street, the community pool offers a refreshing escape just steps from your front door. Your stay includes a complimentary 6-seater golf cart and four bikes, making it easy to explore the nearby beaches, scenic bike paths, and the charming communities of Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and 30A. Whether you're heading to the beach, grabbing coffee, or exploring local boutiques and restaurants, you'll have everything you need for the ultimate coastal adventure. Whether you're planning a family beach vacation or a relaxing getaway with friends, Willow & Waves provides everything you need for an unforgettable stay on the Emerald Coast.The Bed Setup: 2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen Bed3rd FloorLoft Area: Twin Day Bed** Pets are subject to approval. One pet weighing 20 lbs. or less is permitted with an additional $250 pet fee. If you are traveling with a pet, please provide the Reservations Team with your pet's breed within 24 hours of placing your reservation for approval. Failure to do so may result in your pet not being approved for the stay. **This Beautiful home in Inlet Beach is located in a beautiful, coastal community featuring a community pool and a dock for easy access to Lake Powell. It is located just off the east end of iconic 30A, the pinnacle of a Florida coastal lifestyle. This premier development is only a few blocks away from the largest public beach access in Walton County, 30Avenue for shopping and entertainment, Camp Helen State Park, and Inlet and Alys Beach.Area Attractions:Serving as the gateway to 30A, 30Avenue is located at the intersection of Highway 98 and the east entry of famed Scenic Highway 30A. It is a lifestyle center offering exceptional restaurants, boutique shopping, health and beauty services all within easy walking distance of Inlet, Rosemary, Seacrest and Alys beaches.“The Big Chill” is an incredible spot for dining and entertainment nearby. The Big Chill offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila to wings, burgers, and shakes. A stop here is quick, tasty, and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
